export.title: Your data
export.description: Download everything the platform stores about you: profile, organizations, permits with payments, catches with locations, inspections and login sessions — in a single JSON file. Download photos of external permits from their pages.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.intro: Deleting your account cannot be undone:
delete.profile: your first name, last name, email, date of birth and card number will be deleted, and sessions on all devices will be ended;
delete.catches: catches will remain without your data and without locations — organizations see them in statistics;
delete.permits: purchased permits will remain in the organizations' registers without your data; photos and numbers of external permits will be deleted;
delete.organizations: you will lose your roles in organizations — if you are the only administrator of an active organization, give this role to someone else first;
delete.device: unsent catches on this device will be deleted.
delete.lastOrgAdmin: You are the only administrator of an active organization. Give this role to someone else before deleting your account.

accountDeleted.title: Account deleted
accountDeleted.description: Your account has been deleted and sessions on all devices have been ended. Data on this device has been erased.
